title: When Is 0.1% Enough? Analyzing the Combined Effects of Dimensionality Reduction and Quantization on Text Embedding Compression
abstract: arXiv:2606.01074v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent high-performing text embedding models often produce high-dimensional real-valued vectors, resulting in substantial storage and computational costs. To address this issue, embedding compression methods based on dimensionality reduction or quantization have been proposed; however, the effects of their combination have not been sufficiently investigated. In this paper, we systematically investigate how dimensionality reduction and quantization jointly affect embedding compression across four task families in the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB), using five pretrained embedding models. Our results show that combining dimensionality reduction and quantization can preserve near-original performance with substantially smaller storage footprints than either method alone. translated_title: 0.1%何时足够？分析降维与量化对文本嵌入压缩的联合效应
translated_abstract: 近期高性能的文本嵌入模型通常会产生高维实值向量，导致巨大的存储和计算成本。为解决这一问题，研究者提出了基于降维或量化的嵌入压缩方法；然而，两者结合使用的效果尚未得到充分研究。本文使用五个预训练嵌入模型，系统研究了降维和量化如何共同影响嵌入压缩在海量文本嵌入基准（MTEB）四个任务族上的表现。我们的结果表明，将降维与量化相结合，能够以远小于单独使用任一方法的存储占用来保持接近原始的性能。特别是对于分类任务，多个模型仅使用不到原始存储需求0.1%的空间，就能保留至少99%的原始分类分数。
tldr: 本文系统研究了降维与量化相结合对文本嵌入压缩的联合效应，发现在分类任务中仅需不到0.1%的存储空间即可保留至少99%的原始性能。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates the combined effects of dimensionality reduction and quantization on text embedding compression, showing that for classification tasks, models can retain at least 99% of their original performance using less than 0.1% of the original storage.
